 354 | def globs_to_regex(

 360 | 
 361 |     Slashes are always converted to match either slash or backslash, for
 362 |     Windows support, even when running elsewhere.
 363 | 
 364 |     If the pattern has no slash or backslash, then it is interpreted as
 365 |     matching a file name anywhere it appears in the tree.  Otherwise, the glob

 372 |     strings.

 385 | class PathAliases:
 386 |     """A collection of aliases for paths.
 387 | 
 388 |     When combining data files from remote machines, often the paths to source
 389 |     code are different, for example, due to OS differences, or because of
 390 |     serialized checkouts on continuous integration machines.

 393 |     map a path through those aliases to produce a unified path.

 399 |         relative: bool = False,

 418 |         `pattern`, then that match is replaced with `result`.  This models

 420 |         different machines.
 421 |

 423 |         match an entire tree, and not just its root.

 427 |         pattern_sep = sep(pattern)

 429 |         if len(pattern) > 1:
 430 |             pattern = pattern.rstrip(r"\/")
 431 | 
 432 |         # The pattern can't end with a wildcard component.
 433 |         if pattern.endswith("*"):
 434 |             raise ConfigError("Pattern must not end with wildcards.")
